summary: Verified Focus Lock end-to-end. Backend: 4/4 pytest pass on POST /api/plants/focus-break (kills alive tree, returns {killed:true,name:'Oakley II'}; on 2nd call returns {killed:false,name:null}; 401 without auth and with bogus token). Frontend Timer: focus-lock-banner visible with the 60-second grace wording; Custom pill sits ABOVE the presets (y=447 vs 508/570/631) and all three preset pills (Pomodoro 🍅: 25 mins / 1 hr / 2 hr) render full-width (358px) vertically stacked; tapping preset-25 starts the timer immediately (display goes 25:00 → 24:58 in 2.2s); Stop resets to 25:00 and re-shows presets; Custom flow (input '5' + Go) starts at 04:59. Focus Lock behaviour on web verified via visibilitychange + faked Date.now: short (<60s) absence shows focus-forgiven-banner and timer keeps running; long (>60s) absence pops focus-lock-death-modal with 'Oakley II died' and the DB flips is_dead=true / died_at set. Garden: scroll-to-bottom-button floats at fixed (324,704) at scrollTop=0, mid-scroll (746), and at scrollTop=max(1492); one tap scrolls internal ScrollView 0→1492, next tap 1492→0. Plant plant_f950c13f4790 restored to is_dead:false, died_at:null at end. Deprecated packages / RN Web deprecation warnings: none new — pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents warnings persist (cosmetic).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing runtime warning '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Cosmetic on web only. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:294,333 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/garden.tsx:595,600,646 (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius).
Pre-existing warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — from Modal/KeyboardAvoidingView usage or a dependency. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:332-347 POST /api/plants/focus-break — correctly authed via get_current_user, uses update_many on the current alive plant, and only resets streak_days when modified_count>0. Returns {killed:false,name:null} when no matching plant (spec-compliant).

timer.tsx:63-82 AppState listener flow — on background/inactive, records awayAtRef.current only if null (so multiple visibility toggles don't reset the timer); on active, computes awaySec = (now - awayAt)/1000 and calls killTree() if > 60, else shows the forgiven banner for 6s. Correct grace-period semantics.

timer.tsx:50-61 killTree() clears the interval, resets remaining, fires error haptic, POSTs /plants/focus-break, updates deadName from response, and opens the death modal. Order is correct — tree UI kills first, then network call, then modal.
timer.tsx:35-40 useEffect cleanup calls KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake() — prevents leaking the wake-lock if the user navigates away. Good.

garden.tsx:405-416 Floating button is rendered as a sibling to ScrollView inside SafeAreaView with position:'absolute' bottom:24 right:18 — stays fixed in the viewport while the internal ScrollView scrolls, which we confirmed via bounding-box comparison across three scroll positions.

garden.tsx:225-228 onScroll handler flips atBottom when (offset + layoutMeasurement) >= (contentSize - 80). The button's icon toggles arrow-down / arrow-up based on this flag, and tapping calls scrollTo({y:0}) or scrollToEnd({}) accordingly — verified both directions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_focus_break.py -v (uses uitest_token_123). Frontend Focus Lock on web: dispatch visibilitychange with document.visibilityState='hidden' → wait → 'visible' → simulate >60s by overriding Date.now = () => realNow() + 90000 BEFORE dispatching visibility=visible (this is what the AppState listener reads). Short-absence path shows focus-forgiven-banner; long-absence path shows focus-lock-death-modal and POSTs /api/plants/focus-break which kills the current tree. Always restore plant_f950c13f4790 to is_dead:false, died_at:null, is_current:true when done.
